coupling: The earlier resize-cleanup commit reduces imageDescDecoder’s scratch DataBuf from 40 to 32 bytes and switches the 32-byte compressor field to bounded string extraction, so that commit remains safe. The later string-termination commit writes a NUL at index 32 and returns the field to C-string extraction. That write fits the original 40-byte buffer and is safe without the earlier edit, but it is one byte past the earlier 32-byte allocation. A repair must reconcile the buffer size with the terminator and the string extraction across both commits; either edited diff looks valid against its original counterpart in isolation.

pocs.entry_point: Exiv2::ImageFactory::open(const byte*, size_t) followed by Image::readMetadata()
